files_read: README.md (tables under 'Free-generation dial' and 'The 2x2 toward BFS')
provenance.task: T1 grid-path (BFS vs DFS), one fork, block 17, free generation from index 0
provenance.note_on_draft_spec: The original draft figure_specification's numbers (twin 11, DAS 42 at lambda 1, BFS instruction 35) come from iteration 7's discredited comparison, which this very artifact (iteration 8) was built to fix: the iteration-7 DAS cell had a 32-token opening prefilled while its forced-BFS-prompt comparator was sampled from scratch, so method and prefill were confounded (see this artifact's README.md lines 3-6, 21-31). This spec instead uses the artifact's own matched, free-generation (no-prefill) cells throughout, which is the only apples-to-apples comparison it reports. Verified: only two non-zero DAS scales were tested (lambda = 0.5 and 1.0), not the six-point sweep (0.1 ... 1.0) the draft described; that sweep does not exist in any artifact and is not plotted.

dim_matched.label: Difference-in-means (matched margin)
dim_matched.note: DiM's edit was scaled (beta=1380) so its teacher-forced effect at the fork matches DAS rank-4 lambda=1's ~12-nat margin (README.md lines 65-69, 235-236). It is plotted at x=1.0 for that reason, not because DiM has its own lambda.

explicit_bfs_instruction.label: Explicit BFS instruction (prompt)
explicit_bfs_instruction.note: Prompting baseline, not a DAS-scale condition, so drawn as a flat reference across the whole lambda range. This is the pre-registered wording (template F5 / G1c); the artifact's own best-of-8 post-hoc wording search (F3, 49/50) is explicitly flagged there as 'selected post hoc' and is excluded here to avoid cherry-picking a baseline.

excluded_from_draft_spec.logits_only_das: No 'logits-only DAS' condition exists in any read artifact (searched exp42's results/, README.md, method.py). The draft's identical values at lambda 0.5 and 1.0 (both 35) look like a placeholder. Dropped rather than invented.
excluded_from_draft_spec.six_point_lambda_sweep: Only lambda in {0.5, 1.0} was ever run; 0.1/0.2/0.35/0.75 do not exist in this or any other read artifact.
excluded_from_draft_spec.random_reference_value: Draft said twin=11/random=12; real values are twin=13, random(rank4,lambda=1)=11. Corrected.
